reason: $29.99 is more than the Toplux and Goli I already see for $19 to $23, and I don't think most supplements do much unless a doctor says so. A lab report is nice but nobody told me I need magnesium.
objection: I'm paying more than the cheaper brands for something I'm not sure I need, and I already forget my vitamins half the time.
would_change_my_mind: My doctor telling me to take magnesium, and a price close to $20 a month.
